task.maid_odyssey.clean_muffler.desc: Empties the ash out of nearby GregTech muffler hatches.
task.maid_odyssey.clean_muffler.desc_2: Ash goes into her backpack. If it is full she will eat leftover ash (one stack at a time) and lose 1 favorability.
task.maid_odyssey.maintenance_hatch.desc: Repairs broken GregTech maintenance hatches nearby.
Put a wrench, screwdriver, soft mallet, hard hammer, wire cutter and crowbar in her backpack.
task.maid_odyssey.gt_housekeeping.desc: Cleans muffler hatches and repairs maintenance hatches, both at once.
task.maid_odyssey.gt_housekeeping.desc_2: Needs maintenance tools. Ash goes in her backpack; she will eat the overflow if it fills up.
message.maid_odyssey.muffler.cleaned: The muffler hatch is tidy~ collected %s ash for you, Master.
message.maid_odyssey.muffler.voided: That ash was so dirty, I threw away %s of it for you~
message.maid_odyssey.muffler.ate_ash: Uwu… my backpack is stuffed with ash, so I had to eat %s ash. Favorability %s… please leave me a little space next time, Master.
message.maid_odyssey.maintenance.repaire: I fixed %s little problem(s) on this hatch. Please inspect, Master~
message.maid_odyssey.maintenance.duct_ta: I was short on tools, so I patched %s problem(s) with duct tape… please forgive me.
message.maid_odyssey.maintenance.missing: Uu, I cannot repair this hatch. Still missing: %s. Would Master prepare them for me?
message.maid_odyssey.gt.not_installed: There is no GregTech here… this maid has no machines to look after.
message.maid_odyssey.gt.api_mismatch: This maid cannot talk to GregTech: %s
message.maid_odyssey.unreachable: I cannot walk over there, this machine is out of reach…
message.maid_odyssey.hazard.flee: So dangerous! That spot would %s or %s me, I am staying away~
